relevance_note: Trial paper whose Table 1 gives per-subject clinical findings, MRI and ALDH5A1 variants for 19 SSADH-D patients ("ALDH5A1 variant or other method of SSADH-D diagnosis for each subject").
method_note: All 19 enrolled subjects are in scope (SSADH-D diagnosis per Table 1). Table 1 has a 'Patient' column of bare numbers 1-19, so labels are 'Table 1 #<n>'; no per-patient sex, age, family or treatment-response data are given (sex, ages, seizures history, EEG, adverse events, IQ and withdrawals are reported only as unnamed counts, so they were not attributed to anyone). A Python script transcribed Table 1 (rows, cell splitting, variant parsing); its output was checked against the table by hand. Transcript NM_001080.3 is taken from the Table 1 column header. Patients 10-12 have no variant (enzymatic quantification or elevated urine GHB) and get no variant rows. Zygosity recorded only where the cell says 'homozygous' (patients 5, 8, 16); two-variant cells do not state compound heterozygosity or phase, so zygosity is 'not reported'. Variant type and pathogenicity are not stated per variant (the 'two pathogenic ALDH5A1 gene variants' wording is an eligibility criterion, not used). Hedged entries not recorded as observed: 'possible seizures' (#9), 'possible Seizures' (#19), '? Movement disorder' (#15); these checklist items stay 'not reported'. 'developmental delay'/'global delay' not mapped to intellectual disability; 'behavior disorder' (#7, #11, #17) not mapped to aggression/disruptive behaviour. MRI 'normal' (#10, #12) recorded as excluded 'abnormal brain MRI' only; per D-27 it does not exclude the more specific checklist items (T2 hyperintensity, atrophy), which stay 'not reported'. MRI 'not done' (#11, #17) recorded as nothing. Patients #2/#3 and #13/#14 share identical genotypes but the paper does not say they are related; no family labels assigned. Treatment summary is the trial arm assignment stated for all 19 enrolled subjects; three unnamed patients were withdrawn, so not every subject completed both arms. n_patients_reported left null: the authors do not state a count of patients with ALDH5A1 variants (Table 1 lists variants for 16 of 19). Study type recorded as 'other' (randomized controlled crossover trial). No stacked cells. No internal contradictions found.
